mhc_export.assay__comments: The Ka of the Lys(5-FAM) labeled peptides was determined.  Binding isotherms were obtained by fluorescence titrations of peptides with the HLA-A*0201 streptamer. The obtained curves were fitted by a nonlinear regression algorithm to calculate the Ka values.  The Ka values of the N-terminal and C-terminal labeled epitope were calculated as 3.7E7 1/M and 1.3E7 1/M, respectively.  Competition experiments showed that the labeled peptides bound more tightly to A2 streptamers than unlabeled peptide.

mhc_export.assay__comments: Epitope peptides labeled on the N or C terminus with Lys(5-FAM) were bound by HLA-A*02:01 on MCF7 cells.  Binding by the labeled peptides was poorly competed by excess unlabeled peptide, whereas N-terminal labeled peptide was a very strong competitor of unlabeled peptide.  Binding of the labeled peptides to cellular MHC was also shown by T2 stabilization assay.
